1.0 INTRODUCTION:

1.1 To establish policies for drug dispensing in all Inpatient, Outpatient areas.

2.0 SCOPE:-

2.1 Hospital wide

3.0 RESPONSIBILTY:

3.1 Pharmacy In-Charge

3.2 Pharmacists

3.3 Pharmacy Staff

3.4 Doctors

3.5 Nursing staffs

4.0 ABBREVIATION:

4.1 NABH : National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare providers

4.2 MOM : Management of Medication

5.0 DEFINITION:

The preparation, packaging, labeling, record keeping, and transfer of a prescription drug to a patient or an intermediary, who is responsible for administration is known as of the safe dispensing of drug.

6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH: Accreditation Standards For Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1 Documented policies and procedures guide the safe dispensing of medications.

7.2 The policies include a procedure for medication recall.

7.3 Expiry dates are checked prior to dispensing, wherever applicable.

7.4 Labeling requirements are documented and implemented by the organization

8.0 PROCEDURES:-

8.1 The order are screened for appropriateness of drug, dose, and frequency, route of administration, therapeutic duplications, drug-drug interactions, allergies, and formulary status. This shall include both bulk and retail pharmacy. Physician samples shall not be sold.

8.2 All medications are verified by Pharmacists at the time of receipt of goods and the same are checked for damages and contaminations. In case of contaminations, short expiry drugs, expired drugs etc., drugs are recalled. Drugs to be sent back to pharmacy with bills and informed about this status in written to pharmacist. Same is implemented in pharmacy, drugs are returns to Rasashala and vendors from which medicine purchased and documented in recall register.

8.3 Expiry dates are checked prior to dispensing of medicine.

8.4 At a minimum, labels must include the drug name, quantity, and expiry dates. This is applicable to all dispensing areas wherein medicines are dispensed either as cut strips or from bulk containers. Frequency of administration will be explained properly by authorised dispensing person to the patients to their own language.
